mapper.select: SELECT * FROM score WHERE username = #{username} AND num = #{experimentNum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (username, real_name, experiment_id, num, score, submit_time, plagiarism_rate, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{real_name}, #{experiment_id}, #{num}, #{score}, #{submit_time}, #{plagiarism_rate}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT MIN(score_id) as score_id, username, experiment_id, SUM(score) as score, MAX(submit_time) as submit_time, MAX(plagiarism_rate) as plagiarism_rate, MAX(status) as status, MIN(serial_number) as serial_number FROM score WHERE username = #{username} GROUP BY experiment_id, username
